note: UAVDT M0603 (train split: up to 120 of its 2035 frames were in retrain_v1's training set, so detection here is somewhat optimistic). Real drone footage, China (right-hand traffic), signalised four-way intersection, camera looking straight down and still for 68 s (1024x540, 30 fps). Scale from the tracked cars: median car box max(w,h) = 49.6 px over 86 car tracks taken as 4.5 m, so 0.0907 m/px (lanes ~33 px apart = 3.0 m, plausible). Crosswalks traced on frame 1; they are signalised (signal phases not visible), so F1-F5 events here go to review. No lanes drawn: the traffic direction is learned (run_violations.py --learn-flow). No speed limit known, so speeding is not judged. Speeds are estimates (speed_sigma_kmh 3).
